## Description

Combines Neural Delay Differential Equations with Fourier Neural Operators to capture time-lagged memory effects in multi-tenor interest rate term structure propagation.

## Where it may fit

Central bank policy transmission lags, interest rate swap curve forecasting, sovereign bond relative value trading.

## Vehicles

Fixed Income Arbitrage Desks, Global Macro Hedge Funds.

## Required data

Multi-tenor sovereign yield curve histories, policy rate announcement schedules, inflation expectation series.

## Caveats

Delay parameter estimation and mesh-independent operator training require GPU acceleration.
